full_prompt_en: A square expressive oil painting shows a canal bending past a tall brick mill, with a cream-and-black narrowboat moored along the left bank. The water occupies the lower half, breaking the buildings into dark brown and blue-white reflections. At the upper left, a low arched brick bridge frames a smaller pale building across the canal. The narrowboat sits in front of the main brick structure near the center-left; its cream cabin has small dark windows and a thin red line along the roof. Behind it, the mill rises in irregular connected blocks of red and tan brick, with many narrow windows, a dark pitched roof, and one short chimney. A taller industrial smokestack stands farther back on the right. The stone towpath begins broad at the lower right and curves around the building toward the middle distance. Its pale paving slabs are defined by dark seams and warm yellow edges. Canal-side masonry, small shrubs, and adjoining low buildings crowd the bend. The sky is unusually active: white and slate-blue strokes curl in thick repeating arcs across the entire upper band, making the clouds seem to roll above the still heavy architecture. Short, rough paint marks also describe brick, foliage, paving, and water. Reflections under the boat are loosely broken rather than mirrored exactly, while the towpath keeps a clear curved route into the scene. Cool daylight filters through the pale cloud openings from the upper left, lighting the cream cabin and pale stones; dark blue-gray shadow gathers beneath bridge and boat. No people or readable signs appear. The overall composition is restless but grounded, with a curved canal and towpath wrapping around the solid brick mill beneath vigorous swirling clouds.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现性油画呈现运河绕过高大的砖砌工厂，一艘奶油色与黑色窄船停靠在左岸。水面占据下半幅，把建筑打散成深褐与蓝白倒影。左上方，一座低矮砖拱桥框住运河对岸较浅的建筑。窄船位于中左主砖楼前，奶油色船舱上有小深窗，屋顶沿线有一条细红边。其后，工厂由不规则相连的红砖与黄褐砖体块升起，带许多窄窗、深色双坡顶和一根短烟囱。更后方右侧另立着更高的工业烟囱。石砌纤道从右下方宽宽开始，绕着建筑弯向中远景。浅色铺石由深缝与暖黄边界界定。河岸砌体、小灌木与相接的矮楼挤在弯道周围。天空格外活跃：白色和石板蓝色笔触沿上方整条区域卷成厚而反复的弧形，让云仿佛在沉重静止建筑上方滚动。短而粗的油画笔痕也描绘砖、叶、铺地与水。船下倒影松散破碎，没有完全镜像，纤道则保持清楚弯曲的进入路径。冷日光从左上浅色云隙透入，照亮奶油色船舱与浅色石板；深蓝灰阴影聚在桥与船下。没有人物或可读招牌。整体构图躁动却稳固，弯曲运河与纤道环绕坚实砖厂，上方是充满力量的旋云。
style_prompt_en: The expressive oil painting uses thick, visibly worked strokes to keep every surface active. Brick red, ocher, slate blue, cream, charcoal, and muted green form a sturdy earth-and-sky palette. Curving bands and repeated arc marks animate broad upper areas, while angular blocks and dark seams establish solid lower structure. Reflected color breaks into short horizontal fragments rather than exact mirrored shapes. Bright cool passages sit beside heavy brown-black shadow, giving clear depth without smoothing away the paint. The image combines directional perspective with energetic surface movement; lines curve inward while brush marks move across them. The overall effect is vigorous and tactile, with ordinary built forms transformed by restless paint and sky.
style_prompt_zh: 这种表现性油画以厚重、明显反复加工的笔触让每处表面保持活跃。砖红、赭黄、石板蓝、奶油白、炭色与低调绿色组成坚实的大地与天空色域。弯曲色带和重复弧形笔痕激活宽阔上部区域，棱角体块与深色接缝建立坚实下部结构。反射色分裂成短水平碎片，而不是精确镜像。明亮冷色区域靠着沉重褐黑阴影，建立清楚纵深，同时不抹平颜料。画面把定向透视与活跃表面运动结合；线条向内弯曲，笔痕从其上横过。整体效果有力且可触，寻常坚实体块在躁动笔触与上部色域中获得变化。
theme_en: A narrowboat and brick mill reflected in a canal beneath swirling clouds
theme_zh: 旋云下运河中映出窄船与砖砌工厂
name: John Bratby
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
